latest_release.name: v2.0.3
latest_release.body:
### 🚀 Highlights

- 🧩 Custom metadata for frps plugins: the Server tab now lists `[metadatas]` entries with add, edit and remove actions. Imported metadata is preserved instead of being rejected, and it is written back when the frpc config is generated, so plugin requirements such as an instance ID survive a round trip. In multi-user mode `token` stays in its dedicated field, and keys that look like credentials are masked by default with an explicit reveal control.
- 🏷️ Config export attribution: Export config now starts with a comment header containing the Frpc-Desktop version, copyright, project link and MIT license.
- 🫀 Safer heartbeat imports: TOML files and `frp://` links whose `heartbeatTimeout` is shorter than `heartbeatInterval` — a pair frpc rejects — are repaired on import by raising the timeout to the interval. Omitted values keep the 30s / 90s defaults before that check.
- 💾 Precise unsaved-change warnings: the configuration drawer compares the form with the last saved snapshot, so changing a value back no longer triggers the prompt. Edits made while a save is in flight still count as unsaved, as does a metadata draft that was typed but not added.
- 🩺 Cleaner import errors: unreadable or invalid TOML files show the actual reason in the UI, while the application log only records a stable code (B1000) so local paths and configuration contents stay out of `main.log`.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed imported `[metadatas]` tables being rejected as unsupported, which dropped metadata on the next save.
- Fixed `frp://` link imports producing an invalid heartbeat pair.
- Fixed the unsaved-changes dialog appearing after an edit was reverted to its saved value.
- Fixed a metadata draft being discarded without warning when the drawer closed.
- Fixed TOML read failures showing a generic error with no underlying reason.

### 🔄 Upgrading from 2.0.2

- Installs over the existing 2.0.2 app in place. Instances, proxies, server settings, desktop settings and downloaded frpc / cloudflared binaries are kept.
- No database schema changes in this release.
- Existing instances behave as before; their generated frpc config is unchanged unless `[metadatas]` entries exist.
- Exported configs now include a comment header, which frpc ignores.
- The Windows portable ZIP is still available.

Frpc-Desktop

🎉 Cross-platform desktop client for FRP, visual configuration, easily achieve intranet penetration!
All frp versions / Multiple instances / Cloudflare Tunnel / Light & dark theme / Free and open source

🎊 10,000+ Downloads Milestone! Thank you for your support!

📖 Docs   中文

> 💡 If you prefer a **web UI**, try [Podux](https://github.com/luckjiawei/podux) — > the browser-based frpc manager from the same author. ## Download Get the latest packages from [Releases](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/releases/latest): | Platform | Packages | | --- | --- | | Windows | `.msi` and `.exe` installers; portable `.zip` (standalone EXE, x64) | | macOS | `.dmg` (Apple Silicon and Intel) | | Linux | `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm` | Extract the Windows portable zip and run `Frpc-Desktop.exe`. It requires the [Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/#download), which is normally already present on current Windows 10/11 systems. > 2.0 is a full rebuild on Tauri 2 — installers are much smaller than the 1.x Electron builds. ### Install with WinGet (Windows) If [WinGet](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/package-manager/winget/) is available, run the following command in PowerShell or Command Prompt: ```powershell winget install --id luckjiawei.frp-desktop --exact --source winget ``` To update an existing installation: ```powershell winget upgrade --id luckjiawei.frp-desktop --exact --source winget ``` ## What's New in 2.0 - **Rebuilt on Tauri 2** — smaller downloads and lower memory usage than the Electron version. - **Multiple instances** — run several frpc tunnels to different frps servers at the same time. - **Cloudflare Tunnel** — manage cloudflared instances next to your frpc instances. - **New dashboard** — a read-only overview of running instances, proxies, connection errors, and bulk start/stop. - **Refreshed UI** — light, dark, and system themes, collapsible sidebar with animated menu selection, and copyable addresses. Menu animations follow the system's reduced motion preference. Alerts, confirmations (including reset and delete), and input dialogs share a theme-aware style. Prompt descriptions are vertically centered with their status icons. - **Tabbed drawer configuration** — edit each instance's config and view its logs in a side drawer without leaving the page. The frpc settings drawer is split into Instance, Server, Transport, Web Server, and Log tabs, loads the latest saved configuration on opening, and its header contains only the instance title and close button. Instance name and auto connect on startup live in the Instance tab and are saved together with the frpc settings by the drawer's single Save action. If validation fails, the drawer switches to the first invalid field's tab and scrolls to and focuses that field. Card actions are aligned to the left, with Delete and Export config following the other actions. Export config saves the frpc instance's TOML with a comment header containing the Frpc-Desktop version, copyright, and project attribution. The Server tab also lists custom `[metadatas]` entries for viewing, editing, and removal; imported entries are written back when the frpc config is generated. The delete dialog identifies the instance and explains what will be removed before confirmation. - **Independent app log level** — choose how verbose the application log is in System Settings. Instance frpc and cloudflared log levels remain separate per instance. - **Unified instance creation** — New Instance opens one dialog where you pick the instance type. For frpc, create it blank, import a `frpc.toml`, or paste a `frp://` config link shared by Frpc-Desktop; TOML and link imports create the instance, server settings, proxies and Visitors atomically and then open its settings to select an frpc executable. Conflicting monitoring ports are reassigned automatically, relative certificate paths in an imported TOML are resolved against that file's directory, canceling or a failed import leaves no empty instance, and existing instances are untouched. A Copy link action on each frpc card shares that instance's server settings without local TLS paths. No app restart is needed. - **SQLite storage** — automatic, backup-safe import of existing 1.x data. ## TODO - [x] Auto-start on boot - [x] Support multiple users with user & meta_token - [x] Portable version - [x] Add UDP proxy type - [x] Support quick sharing of frps - [x] Add quick local port selection - [x] Support STCP proxy type - [x] Download frp through mirror sites - [x] Support import/export of all configurations - [x] One-click clear all configurations - [x] Support importing and recognizing frpc.toml - [x] TCP and UDP protocols support batch ports - [x] Support multiple languages - [x] Fast proxy search with card/list pagination - [x] Light, dark, and system appearance - [x] Run multiple frpc instances (different frps servers) at the same time - [x] Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) instances alongside frpc ## Development Requirements: Node.js 22.12+, npm, and a stable Rust toolchain ([Tauri prerequisites](https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/)). ```sh npm ci npm run tauri:dev # run the desktop app in development mode npm run tauri:build # build installers for the current platform ``` ## Resource usage The sidebar reports the combined CPU and resident memory of Frpc-Desktop and its descendant processes, including frpc and cloudflared instances started by the app. Values refresh every three seconds. CPU usage is normalized to total machine capacity (0–100%); memory is the sum of process resident memory, so shared pages may be counted more than once. On macOS, WebKit helper processes hosted by system services are outside this process tree and are not included. ## Common Issues ### Upgrading from 1.x Version 2.0 is rebuilt on Tauri and upgrades the 1.x Electron app in place. Your server settings, proxies, desktop settings, and downloaded frpc versions are kept automatically; data still stored in the older NeDB format (1.2.6 and earlier) is imported on first launch and the original files are kept as `*.bak`. Multi-instance support migrates your existing single server into a default instance (`id = "1"`) that cannot be deleted. All existing proxies belong to it, so nothing changes unless you create additional instances. ### Using Cloudflare Tunnel 1. In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to Zero Trust → Networks → Tunnels, create a tunnel with the "cloudflared" connector, and add its public hostnames there. 2. In Frpc-Desktop, open Instances → New Instance → Cloudflare Tunnel, then paste the token (or the whole install command shown in the dashboard) into the instance config. 3. Download cloudflared on the Download page (switch to "Cloudflare Tunnel"), or pick a locally installed binary. If no version is selected, a cloudflared found in `PATH` is used. The app runs cloudflared with its own minimal config, so your `~/.cloudflared/config.yml` is never used by these instances. ### Mac shows app is damaged Run command: `sudo xattr -cr Frpc-Desktop.app` ## Milestones - Follow official account to join group** ## Screenshot ![launch](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/launch.png?raw=true) ![proxys manager](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/proxy.png?raw=true) ![frp download](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/download.png?raw=true) ![config](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/config.png?raw=true) ![logger](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/logger.png?raw=true) ![about](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/main/screenshots/en/about.png?raw=true) ## Donate 👉👉👉[Click to donate](https://jwinks.com/donate/)👈👈👈 ## Contributors ## License [MIT](LICENSE) ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=luckjiawei/frpc-desktop&type=Date)](https://www.star-history.com/#luckjiawei/frpc-desktop&Date) [downloads-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/total.svg?style=for-the-badge [downloads-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/releases [release-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop.svg?style=for-the-badge [releases-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/releases [forks-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/forks/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop.svg?style=for-the-badge [forks-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/network/members [stars-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/stars/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop.svg?style=for-the-badge [stars-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/stargazers [issues-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/issues/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop.svg?style=for-the-badge [issues-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/issues [license-shield]: https://img.shields.io/github/license/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop.svg?style=for-the-badge [license-url]: https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/blob/master/LICENSE

Frpc-Desktop

🎉 FRP跨平台桌面客户端，可视化配置，轻松实现内网穿透！
支持所有frp版本 / 多实例并发 / Cloudflare Tunnel / 浅色与深色主题 / 免费开源

🎊 下载量突破 10,000！感谢大家的支持！

📖 文档   常见问题   English

> 💡 如果你更喜欢 **Web 界面**，试试 [Podux](https://github.com/luckjiawei/podux) — > 基于浏览器的 frpc 可视化管理工具。 ## 下载 前往 [Releases](https://github.com/luckjiawei/frpc-desktop/releases/latest) 下载最新软件包： | 平台 | 软件包 | | --- | --- | | Windows | `.msi` 与 `.exe` 安装包；便携版 `.zip`（独立 EXE，x64） | | macOS | `.dmg`（支持 Apple Silicon 与 Intel） | | Linux | `.AppImage`、`.deb`、`.rpm` | 解压 Windows 便携版 zip 后运行 `Frpc-Desktop.exe`。便携版需要 [Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/#download)，当前的 Windows 10/11 系统通常已预装。 > 2.0 基于 Tauri 2 全面重构，安装包体积比 1.x 的 Electron 版本小很多。 ### 通过 WinGet 安装（Windows） 如果系统已安装 [WinGet](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/windows/package-manager/winget/)，可在 PowerShell 或命令提示符中运行： ```powershell winget install --id luckjiawei.frp-desktop --exact --source winget ``` 更新已安装的版本： ```powershell winget upgrade --id luckjiawei.frp-desktop --exact --source winget ``` ## 2.0 新特性 - **基于 Tauri 2 重构**：安装包更小，内存占用更低。 - **多实例**：可同时运行多个 frpc 实例，连接不同的 frps 服务端。 - **Cloudflare Tunnel**：与 frpc 实例一起管理 cloudflared 实例。 - **全新仪表盘**：只读展示运行中实例、代理数量、连接异常，并支持一键全部启动/停止。 - **界面焕新**：浅色、深色和跟随系统主题，侧边栏可收起，菜单选中背景平滑滑动，地址可一键复制。菜单动画遵循系统的“减少动态效果”设置。提示、重置与删除等确认弹窗及输入弹窗统一样式，并适配浅色和深色主题；提示正文与状态图标垂直居中对齐。 - **Tab 式配置抽屉**：在实例页以右侧抽屉编辑配置、查看日志，无需跳转页面。frpc 配置抽屉分为“实例 / 服务器 / 传输 / Web 界面 / 日志”五个 Tab，打开时自动加载最新保存的配置，右上角仅保留关闭按钮。实例名称和启动时自动连接放在“实例”Tab，与 frpc 配置一起通过底部“保存”按钮一次提交。校验失败时会自动切换到首个错误字段所在的 Tab，并滚动、聚焦到该字段。卡片操作靠左排列，删除和导出配置直接跟在其他操作后面；导出配置可保存该 frpc 实例的 TOML，文件开头附带 Frpc-Desktop 版本号、版权及项目来源注释；“服务器”Tab 还会列出 `[metadatas]` 自定义元数据，可查看、修改和删除，导入的条目会在生成 frpc 配置时原样写回；删除前会在确认弹窗中展示实例信息和删除影响。 - **应用日志级别独立可调**：在系统设置中调整应用自身日志的详细程度，实例的 frpc / cloudflared 日志级别按实例单独设置，两者互不影响。 - **统一的新建实例入口**：点击“新建实例”后在弹窗中选择实例类型。frpc 可以手动填写、导入 frpc.toml，或粘贴 Frpc-Desktop 分享的 frp:// 配置链接；TOML 和链接导入会在同一事务中创建实例、服务端设置、代理和 Visitor，并自动打开配置抽屉供选择 frpc 程序。监控端口冲突时自动分配空闲端口；导入的 TOML 中的相对证书路径会按该文件所在目录转换为绝对路径；取消或导入失败不会留下空实例，已有实例不受影响。每个 frpc 实例卡片提供“复制链接”，分享服务器设置但不包含本机 TLS 文件路径。无需重启软件。 - **SQLite 存储**：自动安全导入 1.x 的现有数据。 ## TODO - [x] 开机自启动 - [x] 适配多用户 user & meta_token - [x] 便携版 - [x] 增加udp代理类型 - [x] 支持快速分享frps - [x] 增加快速选择本地端口 - [x] 支持stcp代理类型 - [x] 通过镜像站下载frp - [x] 支持所有配置的导入导出 - [x] 一键清空所有配置 - [x] 支持导入识别frpc.toml - [x] tcp、udp协议支持批量端口 - [x] support multiple languages - [x] 支持代理快速搜索及卡片/列表分页 - [x] 支持浅色、深色和跟随系统外观 - [x] 支持同时运行多个 frpc 实例（连接不同的 frps） - [x] 支持 Cloudflare Tunnel（cloudflared）实例，可与 frpc 同时运行 ## 开发 环境要求：Node.js 22.12+、npm 和稳定版 Rust 工具链（参见 [Tauri 环境准备](https://v2.tauri.app/zh-cn/start/prerequisites/)）。 ```sh npm ci npm run tauri:dev # 以开发模式运行桌面应用 npm run tauri:build # 为当前平台构建安装包 ``` ## 资源占用 侧栏显示 Frpc-Desktop 及其后代进程的 CPU 和驻留内存合计，包括由应用启动的 frpc、cloudflared 实例，每 3 秒刷新一次。CPU 按整机总算力归一化（0–100%）；内存为各进程驻留内存之和，共享内存页可能重复计入。macOS 中由系统服务托管的 WebKit 辅助进程不属于此进程树，暂不计入。 ## 常见问题 ### 从 1.x 升级 2.0 版本基于 Tauri 重构，可直接覆盖升级 1.x 的 Electron 版本。服务器配置、代理、系统设置和已下载的 frpc 版本会自动保留；仍为旧 NeDB 格式的数据（1.2.6 及更早版本）会在首次启动时导入，原文件以 `*.bak` 保留。 启用多实例后，原有的单个服务端会迁移为默认实例（`id = "1"`），且不可删除。现有代理都归属于该实例，不新建实例时使用方式与之前完全一致。 ### 使用 Cloudflare Tunnel 1. 在 Cloudflare 控制台进入 Zero Trust → 网络 → 隧道，创建连接器为 cloudflared 的隧道，并在控制台中添加公共主机名。 2. 在 Frpc-Desktop 中打开“实例 → 新建实例 → Cloudflare Tunnel”，在实例配置中粘贴令牌（也可以直接粘贴控制台给出的完整安装命令）。 3. 在“下载”页切换到 Cloudflare Tunnel 下载 cloudflared，或选择本机已安装的文件；未选择版本时会使用 `PATH` 中的 cloudflared。 应用会为 cloudflared 生成独立的最小配置，这些实例不会读取你的 `~/.cloudflared/config.yml`。 ##
